config.cooking-balancing.name: Cooking Balance
config.cooking-balancing.tooltip: Ensure cooking dishes always sell for at least the configured profit margin over raw ingredients.
config.cooking-margin.name: Cooking Margin
config.food-quality.name: Food Star Levels
config.food-quality.tooltip: Enables cooked dishes to inherit quality (Silver, Gold, Iridium) from ingredients and enhanced Qi Seasoning.
config.quality-priority.name: Ingredient Priority
config.quality-priority.tooltip: Which ingredients to consume first when cooking.
config.enhanced-buffs.name: Enhanced Food Buffs
config.enhanced-buffs.tooltip: Grants +2 to active stat buffs for Iridium meals and scales buff duration.
config.iridium-buff-duration.name: Iridium Buff Duration
config.iridium-buff-duration.tooltip: Duration multiplier for Iridium-quality meals and drinks (default 2.0x).
config.mead-fix.name: Mead Flavor & Value Fix
config.mead-fix.tooltip: Mead preserves the underlying flower type and scales to 2.0x of the flower honey value.
config.machine-quality.name: Artisan Machine Star Matrix
config.machine-quality.tooltip: Enables the balanced Option 2 Quarter-Step quality matrix (75/25 & 50/25) for artisan machines (Keg, Preserves Jar, Cheese Press, Mayo Machine, Loom, Oil Maker, Dehydrator, Smoker).
config.machine-luck.name: Daily Luck Influence
config.machine-luck.tooltip: Daily luck slightly increases the odds of rolling higher star qualities in artisan machines.
config.quality-preserving.name: Quality-Preserving Machines
config.quality-preserving.tooltip: Artisan machines preserve the input item's star quality through the balanced quality matrix.
config.truffle-oil-fix.name: Truffle Oil Scaling Fix
config.truffle-oil-fix.tooltip: Truffle Oil price and quality scale with the input Truffle, preventing losses on high-quality truffles.
config.truffle-oil-multiplier.name: Truffle Oil Multiplier
config.truffle-oil-multiplier.tooltip: Price multiplier for Truffle Oil relative to the input Truffle value (e.g. 1.5 = 150%).
config.juice-buff.name: Vegetable Juice Buff
config.juice-buff.tooltip: Increases the selling price multiplier for Vegetable Juice brewed in Kegs.
config.juice-multiplier.name: Juice Multiplier
config.juice-multiplier.tooltip: Price multiplier for Vegetable Juice relative to raw vegetable price (default 2.75x, vanilla 2.25x).
config.expanded-aging.name: Expanded Cask Aging
config.expanded-aging.tooltip: Allows Casks to age additional artisan goods such as Vegetable Juice.
config.auto-fruit-drop.name: Auto-Falling Fruit
config.auto-fruit-drop.tooltip: When a mature fruit tree holds the configured number of fruit, all of its fruit automatically falls to the ground overnight.
config.fruit-drop-threshold.name: Fruit Drop Threshold
config.fruit-drop-threshold.tooltip: Number of fruit on a tree that triggers the auto-drop (default 3, the vanilla maximum).
